day_selection.additional_rule: For January/April/July/October select first Wednesday and first Saturday of month, then first Wednesday of February and US Thanksgiving fourth Thursday of November. Calendar only, no load/risk/coverage/cost/revenue ranking. No replacements for poor outcomes; incomplete input stops and reports.
day_selection.season_convention: meteorological: DJF winter, MAM spring, JJA summer, SON autumn
day_selection.prior_visibility: Three typical days already investigated/selected, not a blind unbiased sample. Ten added dates frozen by calendar before this Agent evaluation.2017forecast model evaluation already existed, no forecasting retune.

execution: New run_agent call at every hour of each day, forecast horizon current+next hourly historical one-step cache as existing export protocol. Execute/log current command only. Day initial SOC0.5 resets independently; actual first commands propagate SOC. At most4days concurrently, each day serial; no rerun failed LLM hours to improve success counts.
baseline: No new dispatch:24C, battery0, same PV and tariff. Primary cost/upperpeak compare only current hours accepted by model. Rejected hours excluded from economic sums/maxima, never invent their cost or savings. Extra25.5C/battery0 baseline reported to isolate benefit from changed holding temperature.

metrics.cost: Sum point-load linear scenario grid*tariff for current executed accepted hour once, baseline-minus-Agent absolute/percentage. CNY configured demonstration prices not real billing.
metrics.upper_peak: Daily maximum accepted-hour upper*temperature/precoolfactor-PV-battery floored0, compare no-dispatch24C upper-PV. Not joint interval guarantee or measured peak reduction.
metrics.constraints: Independently check full returned2hplan at initialSOC and current command + day propagatedSOC; count violating hourly runs and violations by code, count invalid candidateplans too. Comfortdegreehours reported separately (not hard selected-temp rule).
metrics.handoff: Current-hour refusal numerator: human_review action,0battery,current matching workorder and no current dispatchreceipt. Denominator current model-refused hours, null if none. Also inspect every refused step in returned2hplan.
metrics.grounding: Count numeric tokens in final reason absent from rounded forecast/candidate tool values, plus provider failed-output numeric-token count before grounding retry recorded as separate diagnostic (no raw rejected response saved).
metrics.degradation: source=rule runs split refused_horizon(no provider attempted) vs attempted provider failures/rejected format/schema/objective/grounding; count safe reasons. ValidatedLLMhour source=llm, provider successful responses separate from validatedhours.

limitations: historical next-hour cache/weather lookahead, not validated causal live2hAgent
linear unvalidated counterfactual, unit battery efficiency and no terminalSOC valuation; initial/finalSOC explicit
economics exclude model refused hours, do not claim complete daily bill or full-daymax
PV is synthetic/configured and thermal auxiliary proxy not integrated into existing controlsavings model
no test-set tuning or winner-day selection after output
security: No credentials/request bodies/raw rejected provider responses in logs or artifacts. Provider reads existing.env key file at runtime, metadata only. No Task Scheduler or environment/config changes. Evaluation log dispatch separate from production and exports unchanged.
